You can use the following JavaScript function to count the occurrences of each character in a string:

```javascript
function countCharacters(str) {
  const result = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const char = str[i];
    if (result[char]) {
      result[char]++;
    } else {
      result[char] = 1;
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```
